description: This file defines cultural information for Albanian (Albania) date and time formatting, including localized names for days and months, date patterns, and parsing functions. It customizes the Date.js library to support 'sq-AL' locale.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a new Date object representing today with time cleared.
